# HSI 2025 – Fourth Conference (Current Event)

![HSI2025 Banner](/assets/HSI2025-banner.png)

Welcome to the Fourth INCOSE HSI International Workshop. This year’s workshop is focussed on knowledge sharing around contemporary HSI practices and how the worldwide community can collaborate towards progressing the field. Join the worldwide community at this virtual series of workshops spread over 2.5 days from November 5-7th 2025.

Our program has been curated to present the interests of the HSI WG members, giving a platform to share, interact and discuss our work and challenges. As this event is fully virtual, we're pleased to offer free registration, however registration is essential to obtain the event meeting links). [**Registration Here**](https://forms.office.com/r/Z4YHudgCt3)

The theme of this year's workshop is: **HSI Now: People, Practice and Potential**.  
Exploring the current landscape of Human Systems Integration through shared insights and evolving expertise.

The three dimensions of this year's theme represent the aims for the workshop.  

- **People** - HSI 2025 is about providing a forum for discussion, bringing together INCOSE WG members as well as other HSI networks and associations.
- **Practice** - Explore the state of practice in HSI, share knowledge and discuss contemporary challenges.
- **Potential** - Seek to build and develop HSI into the future, let HSI 2025 be a catalyst to progressing our fields of work.
